Scrambled eggs cover about 190 x 200 px, which is roughly 12 x 11 cm. They are about 2.5 cm deep, so the volume is about 150 ml, which gives roughly 110 g. A visible orange tint suggests hot sauce or a little shredded cheese. I will count the eggs at 160 kcal/100 g, since they look cooked with some fat and cheese.

The sausage is 4 slices, each about 5 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, so each is about 25 g and the four total about 80 g. Smoked sausage is about 300 kcal/100 g.

The berries are about 5 raspberries at 4 g each, so 20 g, and about 9 blackberries at 5 g each, so 45 g. Together that is about 65 g at about 50 kcal/100 g.
